## Evidence — verified finding

```
modules/MathUtils.rb:4 uses `constant PI to 3.14159`, but `constant` is absent from the keyword table in src/lexer.rs (the 49 keywords include `give`/`back` but not `constant`). `rb run modules/MathUtils.rb` fails with `ParserError: Expected function name`. This is recorded in rbops/baseline.json and currently only WARNS.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Decide whether redblue has module-level constants, then make modules/MathUtils.rb run.
